# CG-REQ-012: Request body added

The operation previously had no request body.

**Why it matters:** A required body invalidates requests without one; an optional one does not.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Detects | `requestBody.added` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> A {kind} request body was added to {operation}.
>
> Existing consumers send no body.
>
> **Fix:** Make the body optional, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: required body added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /jobs: {post: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /jobs: {post: {requestBody: {required: true, content: {application/json: {}}}, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. A required request body was added to POST /jobs.

### Fires: optional body added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /jobs: {post: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /jobs: {post: {requestBody: {content: {application/json: {}}}, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. A optional request body was added to POST /jobs.

### Does not fire: body on both sides

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
        requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-REQ-012
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-REQ-012: { severity: low }
```
